metadata.title: History of Bošany Castle | Restoration and Heritage
metadata.description: Five centuries of history of Renaissance Castle Bošany. From Gothic through Renaissance to 17 years of restoration – a story that refused to be forgotten.

hero.title: Castle Story
hero.subtitle: Five centuries of history, 19 years of restoration

philosophy.title: Restoration Philosophy
philosophy.subtitle: Air conditioning designed 400 years ago
philosophy.description: A meter of stone for your perfect comfort. We reject polystyrene and modern insulation. The thick castle walls provide natural climate - pleasant coolness in summer, warmth in winter.

stages.title: First phase
stages.description: The original building took the form of a three-storey block structure. The corner ashlar work and a fragment of a circular rosette date from this period.

stages.title: Second phase
stages.description: A considerable increase in building mass in height. A painting depicting Samson carrying the gate of Gaza has been preserved.

stages.title: Third phase
stages.description: The building volume was expanded by adding new wings and floors. Fragments of plaster with a painted frieze have been preserved.

stages.title: Fourth phase
stages.description: Extension of the western part of the south-east wing. A rebuilt structure with a fortification character is assumed.

stages.title: Fifth phase
stages.description: The castle acquired its fundamental spatial and bastion form. Pentagonal corner bastions were built.

stages.title: Sixth phase
stages.description: A hexagonal bastion was built on the south-west corner, possibly replacing an older bastion.

stages.title: Seventh phase
stages.description: Attic walls were added around the entire perimeter — the castle acquired a 'fortress' appearance. Rich stucco decoration imitating Botticelli.

stages.title: Eighth phase
stages.description: A staircase tract was built in the central wing. Stucco decoration and stone floors in the interior.

stages.title: Ninth phase
stages.description: Documented by the discovery of a niche for a tiled stove and a stucco cartouche with the inscription 'AD RENOVAT 1794'.

stages.title: Tenth phase
stages.description: The castle acquired a romanticised appearance through modifications to the attic walls and a new wooden roof structure.

stages.title: Eleventh phase
stages.description: The building was adapted for agricultural use — the entire north-west wing was rebuilt into a granary.

stages.title: Twelfth phase
stages.description: Conservation and incomplete reconstruction works. The works were halted after 1989.

highlights.title: Gothic painting of Samson
highlights.description: A fragment of a wall painting with the biblical motif of Samson carrying the gate of Gaza, from the late 15th century, has been preserved in the interior.

highlights.title: Botticelli inspiration
highlights.description: The hexagonal bastion contains a vault with stucco decoration whose centre originally bore a painted composition imitating the Birth of Venus.

highlights.title: Fortress appearance
highlights.description: In the 17th century, attic walls were added around the entire perimeter, giving the castle its characteristic 'fortress' look.

highlights.title: Fortification character
highlights.description: The perimeter walls had a defensive character and served to protect the courtyard. The pentagonal bastions provided a strategic advantage.
